answer: A task carries a small stake and three reviewers from outside the poster's subnet check it before payout. Each reviewer stakes the same amount, so an identity that waves junk through loses its stake when a spot check re-queues the task for a second panel, and only then does the violet payout tag clear. A farm pays one stake per head and faces two panels per task, so filling a harbor with sock puppets burns capital faster than the mesa of cheap rewards returns it.
